title: Post-operative Range Assessment
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Measure the active and the passive extension and flexion at every visit, using the same method, and record all four figures.
Compare with the figures from the previous visit rather than with a population normal, because the trajectory is the finding.
Assess the effusion, since an effusion limits the range and inhibits the quadriceps and resolves.
